title: Channel DNA and style-aware creator workspace
description: Add backward-compatible Channel DNA profiles, deterministic style recommendations, channel-scoped characters/assets, project channel snapshots, and typed Channels UI without changing the legacy production pipeline.
businessContext: Creators need one reusable channel identity and visual grammar so the same topic produces consistent characters, assets, pacing, and storyboard direction across projects.
dependencies: runtime output and character consistency V1.1
existing typed preload IPC and SQLite JSON persistence
acceptanceCriteria: The permanent sidebar exposes Home, Projects, Channels, Asset Library, and Settings while legacy route hashes remain valid.
Channel profiles persist backward-compatible DNA groups for identity, content direction, visual style, characters, assets, and production defaults.
The style catalog contains all eight approved styles and deterministic topic/style/content-direction recommendations distinguish editorial explainer from cute daily-life output.
Project creation can select a channel or explicitly choose no channel and stores a resolved Channel DNA snapshot without breaking legacy projects.
Character, asset concepts, visual routing, prompt preparation, and project build inputs can consume the stored Channel DNA snapshot.
Typed preload IPC validates Channel DNA updates and renderer uses only the typed API.
Focused domain, persistence, service, typecheck, and diff checks pass.
verificationCommands: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/domain/test/channelDna.test.ts packages/domain/test/ipcSchemas.test.ts packages/domain/test/visualRouter.test.ts packages/db/test/persistence.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/assetConceptService.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/promptPreparationService.test.ts
humanEscalationConditions: A migration would risk existing saved project data or user-uploaded files.
A required provider capability cannot be represented by deterministic local metadata and prompts.
